Anna (ml): bringing up nova-lite-8b on dev-stg for a quick sanity/miniprobes pass — can someone help prioritize checks? interested in basic correctness, kv-cache validity, and int8 artefacts.
Raj (infra): +1. start with generation correctness + kv cache replay, then latency tail. I can run infra-side harness. ping me when you have seed prompts.
Anna (ml): posting a tiny prompt set below. want short generative Q/A, a math prompt, and a config-copy to catch tokenization issues.
Anna (ml): Prompt1: "Explain in two sentences why caching helps transformer inference."
Anna (ml): Prompt2: "Compute 17 * 23. Show steps."
Anna (ml): Prompt3: "You are a JSON API — respond only with valid JSON: {"status": "ok", "value": 42}"
Taylor (devex): good mix. also add a system-message style prompt to test role/meta tokens: "System: limit output to 30 tokens". that'll surface off-by-one truncation bugs.
Raj (infra): running quick harness now. command I run:
```bash
./tools/devstg_run.sh --model nova-lite-8b --profile quick-sanity 
# profiles: generation, kv-replay, int8-diff
```
Raj (infra): initial notes: int8 path uses per-layer quantized kernels, small underflow on softmax for long sequences — unlikely for our prompts but will monitor. KV replay looks flaky if we restore with legacy-offsets.
Anna (ml): thanks. can you paste the kv-replay check command and sample expected output? I'll add to the PR for onboarding.
Raj (infra): sure:
```bash
# run kv replay verification (returns PASS/FAIL)
python tools/kv_replay_check.py --model nova-lite-8b --input samples/kv_seed.json
# expected: PASS
# sample output:
# {"check": "kv_replay", "result": "PASS", "mismatches": 0}
```
Taylor (devex): Anna — when you get results, tag @raj and drop a 1-paragraph note about any hallucinations/regressions vs baseline. we'll prioritize blocking issues (json-broken outputs, wrong arithmetic, total crash). non-blocking: slight phrasing/verbosity.
Anna (ml): quick run results pasted:
- Prompt1: good concise answer, ~18 tokens, no hallucination.
- Prompt2: returned "391" (correct) but step-by-step showed missing carry, formatting odd. mark as minor.
- Prompt3: returned malformed JSON: trailing comma and unquoted key. FAIL.
Raj (infra): got same json-fail on our run. kv_replay PASS. int8-diff: small token-level probs in punctuation.
Taylor (devex): json output is blocking for API usage — escalate to model team and mark high priority. create eval ticket referencing exact sample output and seed.
Anna (ml): filing ticket now with logs + reproducer. Will try a quick temperature/decoding tweak to see if decoding params affect JSON.
deploy-bot: deployment started for tag nova-lite-8b@devstg (sha: a1b2c3) — 3 instances. status: rolling. :rocket:
Anna (ml): thanks everyone — will follow up in thread after ticket and quick retest. :thumbsup:
